summary: Move R20 compatibility-session local cleanup after the runtime xrDestroySession result so transient parent failure retains D3D11 binding and LOCAL/session ownership for outer R19 retry.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: Found inner OutRunVrFinalTest::DestroySession destroyed BaseLocalSpace and released Device/Context before calling runtime xrDestroySession, undermining 00470 retry preservation.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Runtime destroy now executes first; local frame mapping, LOCAL/session identity and graphics binding are cleared only on XR_SUCCESS. Explicit BaseLocalSpace child destroy is removed because parent session owns child handle destruction.

evidence.spec_basis: Current Khronos OpenXR states xrDestroySession destroys child handles; xrDestroySwapchain requires submitted graphics commands referencing the swapchain to complete before destruction. Preserve D3D11 binding until the parent result so R19 can retry its completion proof after failure.
